articles.title_en: Christian Democrats most successful party in local elections, Mayors triumph in Prague
articles.lead_en: The Christian Democrats won the most seats in municipal elections held around the Czech Republic on Friday and Saturday. The Mayors and Independents won in Prague, while ANO came first in six regional capitals.
